facts.fact: Tefassil reports that registration and transfer of pupils for the 2026-2027 school year began on 28 September 2026 through the Siraj platform, on the education ministry's timetable, with registration, transfers and corrections open until 20 October; it does not say who keys the entries, the school or the parent.
Tefassil reports that on 28 September 2026 pupil registration and transfers for 2026-2027 opened through the Siraj platform, the ministry urging parents to register their children early.
Tefassil's report of 28 September 2026 presents Siraj as the channel for pupil registration and transfer for 2026-2027 and gives no count or share of schools using it; it does not call it a pilot.

Tefassil reports that the registration and transfer of pupils through Siraj runs to a timetable set by the Ministry of Education and Reform of the Education System, which also issued the call to parents.

systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Reform of the Education System
systems.tiers: pupil registration, transfer and correction of status for 2026-2027, 28 September to 20 October 2026; no level of schooling named

note: Classed emis as a learner register: the article says pupils are registered and transferred through the platform once a year, and nothing about attendance or results. It names no school level and gives no figure.
